issues.description: Radar chart with 6 dimensions (Warmth, Complexity, Organic, Layered, Heritage, Character) is missing from the visible screen area
issues.root_cause: The radar chart component is likely either not rendered, rendered below the fold without proper positioning, or the component has a hydration error causing it to not mount. The multiple 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' hydration errors suggest server/client mismatch, likely due to Math.random() or Date-based values used in chart data generation without being wrapped in useEffect or suppressed with suppressHydrationWarning.

issues.description: Hydration errors (7 instances) causing entire root to switch to client rendering, which means server-rendered chart/dynamic content mismatches client
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-4/page.tsx, dynamic values (likely random scores for the 6 radar dimensions or color palette generation) are computed during render without being deferred to client-side only via useEffect or useMemo with stable seeds. This causes SSR output to differ from client render.

issues.description: Tweak input field is missing from the visible UI — spec requires a tweak/refinement input field on this screen
issues.root_cause: The tweak input field is either not implemented in apps/web/app/design/step-4/page.tsx or conditionally hidden due to a state/rendering issue caused by the hydration failure switching to full client rendering.

fixes.reason: Wrapping radar data in useMemo with a stable dependency prevents recalculation between SSR and client render, fixing hydration mismatch
Close the useMemo for radarData array with stable empty deps array
Wrap RadarChart in a ClientOnly boundary to prevent SSR from attempting to render the chart and causing hydration mismatch with dynamic/random dimension values
